en.title: Why Could No One Stop the Mongols? | Mongol Empire Ep. 1
en.description:
Maybe a million herders tore down empires of tens of millions. How? It started with one number - and a khan who rebuilt his entire army around it. From the Great Wall of China to a massacre on the Silk Road, this is where the Mongol Empire truly begins.

0:00 How did they do it?
0:22 The number 10: inside the Mongol army
4:53 Beyond the Great Wall
8:38 A massacre on the Silk Road

Dialogue is dramatized from the historical sources below.
Narration and character voices are AI-generated.

Sources and images:
- The Secret History of the Mongols (13th c.)
- Ata-Malik Juvaini, History of the World Conqueror (13th c.)
- Rashid al-Din, Jami' al-tawarikh (14th c.)
- Giovanni da Pian del Carpine (Carpini), History of the Mongols (1247)
- Yuan Shi (History of Yuan, 14th c.)
- Shihab al-Din al-Nasawi, Life of Sultan Jalal al-Din (13th c.)
